summary: Alvotech filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing FDA acceptance for review of a Biologics License Application for AVT80, a proposed interchangeable biosimilar to Entyvio (vedolizumab) in prefilled syringe and autoinjector forms. The filing is routine regulatory progress reporting, not a special situation. No deal terms, board actions, or structural changes are involved. The registrant acts solely as the filer reporting a milestone in its biosimilar program under its Teva partnership.
